description: The lowest full-time pay a Finnish collective agreement (TES) sets for a role at entry level: the agreement, pay group and step, the monthly and hourly minimum, the date the pay table took effect, whether the agreement binds every employer in its field, and a link to the agreement page. Fits "what is the minimum pay for a cook in Finland" or checking an offer against the agreement. Covers roles that map onto one agreement's pay table (retail, restaurants, construction, security, IT, health and social care and a few more); other roles return not covered. Table minimums, not typical pay (typical pay comes from pay_for_role). Reuse: figures may be quoted with a visible link to the jobcrawls.com page in the result (or "JobCrawls (jobcrawls.com)" where a link is impossible); each result repeats this in dataUse.
